appDesc.message: Sends browser downloads and media to Falcon DM.

youtubeHint.message: YouTube: Falcon downloads via yt-dlp from the watch page (avoids CDN 403). Best quality is merged automatically.

qualityHint.message: Choose quality and format. HLS streams are merged automatically by Falcon DM.

errorJunkUrl.message: Not a real video URL — play the video and pick a quality card

errorWaking.message: Could not start Falcon DM — install the app or open it manually

errorMediaUtils.message: Falcon module failed to load — reload extension

errorAppOffline.message: Falcon DM is not running — open the desktop app

errorExtensionBlocked.message: Extension blocked — Falcon DM Settings → Reconnect extension

errorInvalidUrl.message: No valid video URL — try another source

errorNoValidSource.message: No downloadable URL — play the video and try again

errorRateLimit.message: Too many requests — try again shortly

appClosedFallback.message: Falcon DM offline — using browser download

grabberEmpty.message: No downloadable links found on this page

optionsDesc.message: Connects automatically when Falcon DM is open. No token paste needed.

optionsHint.message: If blocked: Falcon DM → Settings → Reconnect extension, then Connect now.

optionsConnected.message: Connected — downloads go to Falcon DM

popupOnboard.message: Open Falcon DM and approve this extension in Settings
